name: Boon of Spell Recall
summary: +1 Int, Wis or Cha (max 30); when you cast with a level 1-4 slot, roll 1d4 and keep the slot if it matches.

benefits.name: Free Casting
benefits.summary: Casting with a level 1-4 slot: roll 1d4; if it equals the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.
benefits.text: Whenever you cast a spell using a level 1, 2, 3 or 4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number rolled equals the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.
